nodes.title: Card vault
nodes.blurb: Stores tokens, not raw card numbers.

stages.blurb: The checkout page files come from a CDN. The charge itself goes through a payments API—not your shop’s own database.
The system knows which shop is charging, creates a payment intent, and scores fraud before money moves.
Cards are saved as tokens, not raw numbers. A cache stops a double-click from charging twice.
A ledger is the money diary. Merchant settings (payouts, webhooks) sit in a different database.
“Paid” emails to the shop and bank payouts happen after the tap, in the background.
Visa/banks authorize the card. An audit trail keeps a copy of what happened.
